name: single arm push up (wall supported)
description: An easier one-arm push-up using a wall, building the strength and stability needed for the full floor version.
instructions: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
